note: The Catechism, the reference text of catechesis, teaches natural knowability in Dei Filius's words. Gaps: it is addressed chiefly to bishops and catechists (CCC 12, read but not pinned), so it is the teaching the faithful receive, not evidence of what they affirm; and CCC 37-38 stress the historical difficulties of such knowledge. No pinnable survey of ordinary believers is recorded.
